jobs.description:
Security Officer - Full Time Hotel Patrol

Overview


Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description


As a Security Officer - Full Time Hotel Patrol in San Antonio, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Hotels & Resorts, and more. As a Patrol Unarmed Officer at a hotel and resort location, you will monitor and patrol assigned areas, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, and provide welcoming customer service to guests and staff. You will communicate clearly, respond to security-related concerns, and support a positive environment. Join Allied Universal, where agility, reliability, innovation, teamwork, and integrity guide our people-first culture.

Position Type: Full Time

Pay Rate: $15.67 / Hour

Job Schedule:

What You'll Do:

  • Provide exceptional customer service to guests, visitors, and staff while carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities at a hotel and resort location.
  • Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols of guest areas, entrances, parking areas, amenities, and the property perimeter to help deter unauthorized activity and identify potential concerns.
  • Respond to incidents, guest concerns, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following established reporting and escalation procedures.
  • Monitor access points and observe activity throughout the property, reporting unusual conditions, maintenance concerns, and policy violations to appropriate personnel.
  • Complete accurate activity logs, incident reports, and shift documentation in accordance with Allied Universal and site-specific requirements.

Minimum Requirements:

  • A Guard Card or license is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Summary

At Hyatt, we believe our guests select Hyatt because of our caring and attentive associates who are focused on providing efficient service and meaningful experiences.

The Loss Prevention Officer plays a vital role in preventing theft and keeping the hotel guests, customers, and colleagues safe. This is a fast-paced position with customer-facing interaction that requires organization and excellent communication skills. The ideal candidate will be able to work at minimum a couple of times a month, and on weekends and holidays.

Responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

  • Conduct foot patrols throughout the property
  • Respond to medical emergencies on the premises
  • Assist customers, guests, and colleagues with any security related issues or questions
  • Monitor and review camera footage
  • Assist with security office duties - answer phones, dispatch calls, sign in visitors, and conduct bag checks
  • Perform all duties as assigned by the Security Supervisor and Security Director

Benefits:

  • Discounted Hyatt Hotel Rooms
  • 401(k) Match
  • Free Meals Provided in Employee Cafeteria
  • Opportunities for Career Growth
  • Discounted employee parking

Hyatt associates work in an environment that demands exceptional performance yet reaps great rewards. Whether it's career opportunities, job enrichment or a supportive work environment, if you are ready for this challenge, then we are ready for you.


Qualifications

  • A true desire to satisfy the needs of others in a fast-paced environment
  • Refined verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time and walk moderate distances
  • Must be able to work at minimum a couple of times a month, and on weekends and holidays.
  • Preferred candidates will be able to work at least one combination of shifts. Options are as follows:
    • mornings and evenings
    • evenings and overnights
    • overnights and mornings
  • Proficient in basic computer skills
  • Preferred candidates will have 1 year of previous hotel security experience
  • AED and CPR Certifications are a plus.

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Loss Prevention Officer (Hotel Emma)-$18.00/hr. (Hotel Emma)
jobs.description:
Loss Prevention Officer


Hotel Emma is seeking a service-driven, detail-oriented Loss Prevention Officer who is passionate about safety, guest care, and protecting the integrity of our property.


Primary Responsibilities



  • Conduct routine patrols of the hotel, exterior perimeter, guest floors, stairwells, mechanical rooms, storage areas, public spaces, and back-of-house areas throughout the shift to ensure a safe, secure, and well-maintained environment.

  • Monitor cameras, access points, elevators, exterior doors, and other security systems to identify and respond to unusual activity, safety concerns, and operational issues.

  • Check in regularly with operational departments, including Front Office, Housekeeping, Food and Beverage, and other hotel outlets, to communicate presence on shift, gather updates, and support developing needs.

  • Conduct radio, key, and access audits to ensure equipment and controlled items are properly signed out, accounted for, and escalated immediately when discrepancies are identified.

  • Inspect guest and hotel vehicles, including house cars and golf carts, to confirm cleanliness, mileage, condition, and damage status, and complete required inspection documentation each shift.

  • Support transportation and valet-related security by auditing locked vehicles, monitoring vehicle handling standards, and reporting concerns to hotel leadership as appropriate.

  • Respond promptly to incidents, guest concerns, accidents, disturbances, alarms, and emergency situations; administer First Aid or CPR when necessary and contact EMS or emergency responders as appropriate.

  • Assist guests with room access, safety concerns, welfare checks, and general support needs while maintaining professionalism, discretion, and hospitality standards.

  • Identify, address, and document safety hazards, maintenance concerns, cleanliness issues, and security risks, including submitting or coordinating work orders through the appropriate systems.

  • Maintain security of restricted areas, lock and unlock designated spaces as required, and verify that access-sensitive locations remain properly secured.

  • Manage lost and found processes by recovering, documenting, storing, returning, and escalating guest items in accordance with hotel procedures.

  • Investigate, label, coordinate, and communicate guest package handling and delivery activity in alignment with hotel procedures.

  • Document all incidents, investigations, daily activity reports, and shift summaries accurately and thoroughly in accordance with Risk Management and hotel reporting standards.

  • De-escalate guest or associate disturbances, escort unwelcome individuals from the property when necessary, and support management in maintaining a calm, orderly, and service-focused environment.

  • Support overnight and operational needs across departments as necessary, including assisting with follow-up tasks, security checks, and property readiness expectations.


Job Requirements



  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience in loss prevention, security, risk management, transportation support, or a related field, preferably in a luxury hotel, residential, or hospitality environment. Previous guest service experience required, with the ability to balance security responsibilities with a warm, service-oriented approach.

  • Certifications and Licensing: Current CPR and First Aid certification preferred or ability to obtain within a designated timeframe. Must maintain a valid Texas driver license with at least one year of driving experience and an exemplary driving record and must be able to successfully pass initial background and driving record screening.

  • Communication: Strong English communication skills, both spoken and written, with the ability to interact clearly and professionally with guests, residents, service partners, property management teams, team members, and leadership. Must be able to communicate calmly and effectively during emergencies, provide concise and accurate updates when escalating incidents, and demonstrate polished hospitality etiquette in all interactions.

  • Schedule Flexibility: Must be available to work a flexible schedule, including overnights, weekends, holidays, and emergency call-in situations as business needs require.

  • Physical Requirements: Must be able to stand and walk for extended periods, climb stairs, respond quickly in emergency situations, and occasionally lift or move moderate weight.

  • Safety, Driving, and Compliance: Must meet all safety requirements of the role, including while driving guest and hotel vehicles. Must follow all safety rules and procedures while driving, including wearing a seatbelt, refraining from cell phone use while driving or while in the vehicle, and complying with all Texas driving laws. Texas driver license must be in the associate’s possession while driving any vehicle and while on shift. Must immediately notify the manager on duty of any accident or incident involving a guest or hotel vehicle, communicate within 48 hours of any moving violation or driving accident whether on or off the job, and provide immediate notification of any change in Texas driver license status and/or health status that may affect driving ability, including corrective lens requirements, name changes, or medication-related limitations. Annual driving record checks will be conducted through the Hotel’s screening company to confirm compliance with minimum insurance requirements, and additional driving record checks may be conducted as needed at the discretion of Hotel Emma. Per insurance requirements, associate must also be able to pass any required post-accident drug testing.

  • Vehicle Operation and Transportation Coordination: Must be able to operate a variety of vehicle types, including manual transmission and any vehicle within Class C requirements. Must also be able to coordinate third-party transportation partners, ride-share support, and guest access accurately and without error.

  • Safety and Conflict Resolution: Demonstrated ability to identify safety concerns, follow emergency response and fire/life safety procedures, and de-escalate tense situations with professionalism, sound judgment, and composure.

  • Technical Skills: Strong computer skills required, including the ability to complete incident reports accurately and use standard Microsoft Office programs. Experience with radios, surveillance systems, access control systems, or other incident-reporting tools preferred.

  • Professionalism and Discretion: Must handle sensitive information with strict confidentiality and demonstrate professionalism, reliability, and attention to detail in all interactions and documentation.

jobs.title: HOTEL SECURITY
jobs.description:
Our Hotel Security:
Remains knowledgeable of hotel security policies, procedures, rules, and regulations.

Remains knowledgeable of emergency procedures, operation of alarm doors, fire alarms, and key orientation.

Patrols allocated areas of hotel and property as directed and watch for suspicious, irregular, prohibited, or dangerous activities, situations, or persons, as outlined in hotel policy.

Patrol premises to prevent and detect signs of intrusion and ensure the security of doors, windows, and gates.

Manages the collection, safeguarding, and redistribution of lost and found items.

Circulates among visitors, patrons, and employees to preserve order and protect property.

Answers alarms and investigates. Investigates disturbances by addressing the violator and the complainant. Takes action to resolve the disturbance in the best interest of the hotel.

Monitors and authorizes entrance and departure of employees, visitors, and other persons to guard against theft and maintain the security of premises.

Warns violators of rules infractions and expels persons who pose danger to the hotels well-being, using force when necessary. Follows-up with warned and expelled persons to ensure their compliance.

Calls police, fire department, or ambulance in cases of a medical emergency, or any dangerous or threatening condition such as fire, presence of unauthorized persons, or non-compliant violators of hotel policy.

Takes initiative to notify or warn guests and hotel staff of dangerous conditions or areas on the hotels property such as fires, floods, construction sites, slippery floors, etc.

Takes the initiative to advise guests or staff of emergency situations or the need to abandon facilities. Follows up with persons in danger to ensure their safety.

Writes reports of daily activities and irregularities, such as equipment or property damage, theft, presence of unauthorized persons, or unusual occurrences.

Adheres to strict confidentiality of all information.

Works as a team with other security officers, staff and departments for the well-being of the hotel and guests.

Maintains logs and/or records of activity during the scheduled shifts.

Inspects and adjusts security systems, equipment, and machinery to ensure operational use and to detect evidence of tampering.

Knowledge and use of radio procedures, zone orientations, and telephone.

Provides assistance and/or information to guests and others when necessary.

Provides a professional image at all times through appearance and dress.

Follows company policies and procedures.

jobs.title: Security Specialist/HARPS Guard I - PT On Call Floater hours
jobs.description:
Position: PART-TIME PT Floater hours


SCHEDULE: on-call floater hours


Specific Tasks. The following tasks are general duties for the HARPS personnel. Contracting Personnel (CP) providing service at JBSA-Lackland and Randolph, AFB shall perform the following tasks below;

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS: • Monitor all electromagnetic door locks, door contact switches, duress alarms and answer all telephone calls within the HARPS/Information Desk Control Area. This area is defined as the Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) room, and the adjacent administrative area commonly referred to as the Information Desk. • Personnel will monitor the Identipass, Genetech, and Premisys access control systems. • Initial training for these systems will be provided by a company representative of which the system is being provided by. The contractor will then be responsible to train any new CP thereafter. • The government will phase out any of the systems that will eventually no longer be in use. • Operate, observe and evaluate CCTVs within the HARPS/Information Desk Control Area. • Use the Government provided radio system to notify the Facility Management staff and/or the base installation Security Forces on any alarm or police response situations. • Monitor operations and status of overall security network for the MTF from the centralized console. • Operate HARPS/Information Desk intercom system master station at the console to communicate with entry/exit points or incident locations. • Utilize overhead paging system to notify personnel of emergency codes and alarms. Communicate all information in a clear and concise manner. • Operate video recorder and playback at the request of Facility Management personnel. • Maintain security log and activate control devices for interior and exterior doors. • Receive transfer calls from designated wing agencies and take messages or forward calls to appropriate agencies. • Report and initiate an action report log on any emergency situation and provide comprehensive information to responding agencies and Facility Management staff when appropriate. • Maintain up to date roster of on-call and emergency contact personnel for required areas. • The CP report to an appropriate authority (DCS Supervisors, Security Forces, and Facility Managers) any information or circumstances, which may pose a threat to the security of DoD personnel, contractor personnel, resources, and classified or unclassified defense information. • Maintain Chronology of Events, Access Control logs and Alarm Reports at all times. Event logs will be documented in a professional manner utilizing appropriate grammar and punctuation and include all pertinent information covering the parameters of “Who, What, When, and Where.” Event logs will be sent to Facility Management on a daily basis no later than 0800 hrs. These documents are for official use only. • CP shall perform and document physical checks of assigned buildings, rooms and areas when electronic systems are degraded. This includes manual fire watch procedures when fire alarm systems are down and checks of controlled areas such as pharmacies when Intrution Detection Systems (IDS) are degraded. • Act as the information focal point for all medical groups' personnel, patients and visitors on all resource protection activities and the liaison on these issues to the facility management office.


Qualifications.

  1. Have 12 months of experience as an alarm monitor or dispatcher, either in the military or civilian sector, within the last 3 years.
  2. Skills and Knowledge. Must be able to use, at minimum, Access Control System, Genetech, and Microsoft Programs such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  3. Shall be capable of sitting for an extended period of time during the course of their 8-hour shift, but are able to get up and move about within the area. CP shall be capable of bending, reaching, and lifting a minimum of 30 pounds to move and retrieve records or equipment, and may require prolonged walking and or standing.
  4. Personnel must be able to communicate in a clear and concise manner and demonstrate a calm demeanor during high-stress situations

jobs.title: Mobile Patrol Security Officer-nights & multiple stops
jobs.description:
About us

We are a local security company looking for loyal and committed workers to serve our clients all around the San Antonio and surrounding areas. *We have immediate positions for hire* and pay weekly! Serious applicants only please who are willing to work night shifts and use their own vehicle.

IMMEDIATE HIRE FOR QUALIFIED Serious APPLICANTS

Must have current and valid drivers license.

Reliable personal vehicle to use during shift.

Level 2 or 3 Commission card in hand.

Must have own weapon and gear if level 3.

Additional pay per mileage

Contract Work

Work Location:

  • On the road
  • Multi sites

We are seeking licensed Security Guards to become an integral part of our team. The selected individuals will patrol and secure assigned multiple premises (multifamily homes) as well as identify risks to staff and patrons. Full and part time opportunities available. Must be available to work all shifts and have own proper transportation.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor multiple premises to prevent theft, violence, or infractions of rules
  • Makes periodic tours of entry/exits, buildings and grounds of assigned client site
  • Thoroughly examine doors, windows, and gates to ensure proper function and security; if not, takes appropriate action if needed
  • Warn violators of premise rules and regulations within guidelines
  • Report any facility issues such as fire hazards and leaking water pipes
  • Request emergency personnel for high risk situations

​Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in security, law enforcement, or other related fields
  • Ability to accurately key information into data system
  • Ability to work weekends, holidays, shift work, and extended hours (reliable)
  • Performs administrative duties (e.g., guard post reports, daily activity reports, and associated documentation)
  • Maintains safety awareness; reports incidents / violations
  • Familiarity with security equipment
  • Ability to handle physical workload
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to remain calm in emergency situations
  • Use personal vehicle

Uniform:

Shirt will be provided, must have black pants, belts and shoes.

- Note: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Worker may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

Job Types: Full-time, Part-time, Contract

Pay: $17.00 - $19.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
